summary: Cameco Corp. along with Orano Canada Inc. agreed to acquire TEPCO Resources Inc.'s 5% participating interest in the Cigar Lake Joint Venture via a Form 6-K filed with the SEC, equivalent to a material definitive agreement. Cameco will pay approximately $115.75 million (CAD) for its share, increasing its stake by 2.871 percentage points to 57.418%. The board recommends the transaction, which is subject to regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. Expected to close in Q3 2026, the deal enhances Cameco's ownership of a top-tier uranium mine. Watch for regulatory clearances; the risk-arb spread will depend on approval timelines.
